seoTitle: DeKalb County School Calendar 2025-2026: Holidays, Breaks & PDF
seoDescription: DeKalb County School District 2025-2026 calendar with first day, last day, holidays, Fall Break, Winter Break, Spring Break, PDF, and ICS.
calendarNotes: DeKalb County School District starts the 2025-2026 school year on Monday, August 4, 2025 and ends the student year on Thursday, May 28, 2026. The Board-approved calendar totals 180 instructional days, with 89 instructional days in the first semester and 91 in the second semester. Fall Break runs October 14-17, Thanksgiving Break runs November 24-28, Winter Break runs December 22-January 2, February Break runs February 17-20, and Spring Break runs April 6-10. The calendar also lists virtual teacher workdays, independent learner/professional development days, pre-planning, post/pre-planning, and post-planning days.

calendarFaqs.q: When does DeKalb County school start in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: The first day of school for DeKalb County School District is Monday, August 4, 2025.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for DeKalb County in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day of school is Thursday, May 28, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is DeKalb County Spring Break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Monday, April 6 through Friday, April 10, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Winter Break for DeKalb County School District in 2025-2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs Monday, December 22, 2025 through Friday, January 2, 2026. January 5 is a post/pre-planning day, and the second semester begins January 6.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Fall Break for DeKalb County Schools in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: Fall Break runs Tuesday, October 14 through Friday, October 17, 2025.

calendarFaqs.q: How many instructional days are in the DeKalb 2025-2026 calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: The official Board-approved 2025-2026 calendar totals 180 instructional days, with 89 in the first semester and 91 in the second semester.

calendarFaqs.q: What are DeKalb virtual teacher workdays in 2025-2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The official calendar lists virtual teachers' workdays on October 13, 2025 and February 16, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: What are independent learner days on the DeKalb 2025-2026 calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: The official calendar lists independent learner/professional development days on November 4, 2025 and March 13, 2026.
